_note: Income that comes from what the company already does (claude/income, 2026-10-22; Captain: "we need something that allows the players to make money... like good money but it needs to go with the flow of the game"). docs/income.md has the design. Every number here is Proposed and tunable; Income, SideJobs, Bounties, FobBusiness and BlackMarket read them.
_side_jobs: High command squads' own jobs (SideJobs). Offers come from employers and fixers that will deal with the company (Neutral or better; a fixer at its min_rep), one region's zone each, and expire after offer_days. The squad is away for the job's days and resolved off-screen by a risk roll: the job's risk x the zone's danger (the living war: who holds it, how strong, a front there) against the squad's quality (skill, kit, morale, men ready). pay = base_pay x (pay_floor + danger x pay_danger) x the client's pay rate; advance_share of it up front, kept whatever happens. trouble = risk x (trouble_base + danger) x (trouble_quality - quality), then a second roll decides wounds, a man lost, or the job failing.

kinds.name: Escort a client
kinds.brief: Close protection for a client moving through the zone: in, the meeting, out.

kinds.name: Guard a site
kinds.brief: Hold a client's site (a depot, a pumping station, a clinic) against whoever comes.

kinds.name: Train locals
kinds.brief: Drill a village militia: weapons handling, a patrol, a checkpoint. The locals remember who taught them.

kinds.name: Run a supply route
kinds.brief: Ride shotgun on trucks between two towns and see them through every checkpoint.

kinds.name: Deliver a capture
kinds.brief: Drive a captured vehicle or gun from FOB storage to the buyer, who pays more for it delivered. Lose it on the way and it is gone.

_danger: A zone's danger for side jobs and business raids, 0..1 (Income.zone_danger): the holder (the company or the rebels: company; an employer that will deal with the company: friendly; anyone else: hostile, plus its war strength / strength_div), plus front if somebody is attacking it, less grip_calm x (grip - 0.5) for a firm friendly hold.
_captures: Captured vehicles and heavy weapons (Bounties): a stored vehicle lot sells to a buyer at its value (data/pallets.json vehicle_values) x mult x what the buyer pays the company for its standing (Economy.pay_mult), once the company stands at min_rep with it; rep is the buyer's standing gained, lawful_hit every lawful faction's (arming a militia). "models": only those. deliver_mult: a high command squad drives it to the buyer (a side job, its risks; failed, the lot is lost). FOB storage alone sells at 0.8 of value (pallets.json sell_stored_ratio).
_bounties: Bounties on the living war's leaders (Bounties): by the leader's role (factions.json leader_roles), x (1 + the faction's war strength / 100 x strength_bonus), posted by the lawful employer at war with it the company stands best with; dead (an hvt_kill, with its proof) dead_mult of it; rep with the poster when paid.
_intel_buyers: Intel sold in the debrief (Bounties.intel_price): its worth (Prices.intel_sale_value) x mult by the kind of buyer; rep with the buyer; lawful_hit with every lawful faction. subject: the faction the intel is about, buying it back; rival: a hostile faction at war with the subject; fixer: a fixer's faction; lawful: the lawful forces.
_businesses: FOB businesses (FobBusiness), once home is a FOB the company holds: open one for setup, then each day it costs upkeep (its local staff's pay in it) and uses its supplies (FOB stocks: Economy.stock), and pays: pay + per_unit x its units (convoy: friendly-held road zones in reach; tolls: company-held zones with a route or crossing, the FOB's own road counting one; rentals: vehicles at home in the motor pool; the camp: none). Short of supplies it pays short_pay of that. Each day raid_base + raid_danger x the FOB's danger is the chance raiders threaten one: a protection contract (Hold the line) goes on the board for threat_days; done, the threat lifts and the locals think better of the company; not done by then, the business is raided: closed raid_days, raid_cost_share of its setup to put right. The FOB lost: every business goes with it.

kinds.name: Convoy security
kinds.brief: Your men ride with the locals' trucks between the towns you can reach safely, for a fee per run.

kinds.name: Militia training camp
kinds.brief: Train the region's militia at the FOB. The village councils pay a little; the region's rebel support rises every day it runs.

kinds.name: Checkpoint tolls
kinds.brief: Checkpoints on the roads the company holds: every truck pays to pass. More roads held, more tolls; the locals like it less.

kinds.name: Motor pool rentals
kinds.brief: Rent the motor pool's idle vehicles to aid agencies and traders. Wear costs parts.

_market: Black market (BlackMarket): goods' base prices; a region's price x (1 + front x the share of its war zones with a front + hostile x the share held by enemies + cartel x the share held by predatory groups or the cartel + lawful x the share held by lawful forces or the company); a fixer's own lean instead (only what it deals in). Noise each day; spread between buy and sell; selling pressure_per_unit a unit drives that market's price down, easing pressure_decay a day. Cargo: capacity_base + capacity_per_vehicle a motor pool vehicle. Risks a day: contraband found contraband_risk x (1 + units/10) x (1 + the US's war strength/100 while it's at war): seized, fine_share of what it cost as a fine, contraband_rep with US Forces and -1 with the other lawful; weapons noticed weapons_risk the same way (-1 US); theft at a FOB theft_risk x its danger x 2 (40% of one good).
